[size=6][center][b][font=Times New Roman][color=#ffff00][quote]You can get ore even if you don't like mining!?[/quote][/color][/font][/b][/center][/size][size=5]
[/size][center][size=5][b]It is a strange fruit tree whose trunk and leaves are made of stone.[/b][/size][b]
[size=5]As it grows, it bears not fruit but a [/size][size=6]﻿”[color=#e69138]High[/color] [color=#c9daf8]Purity[/color] [color=#ffff00]Ore[/color] [color=#ff00ff]Node[/color]”[/size][size=5].[/size]
[/b][size=5][b]And we have original machines to process it.[/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]The prices of seedlings and fruits (node) are adjusted so that the game is not unbalanced to some extent. ... maybe.[/size]

Each of the four types of fruit trees bears fruit in the corresponding season.Some varieties may even bear fruit in winter!
(The all-season fruiting in the media images are from other mods for the photo shoot.)

Ore node buds appear on fruit trees in the fruiting season and the trees themselves appear a little brighter.

English and Japanese are supported.


[size=3]Much information is hidden.[/size]
[size=3]If you want to know quickly, click below to check it out.[/size]

Here are the types and descriptions of things that will be added.

[color=#ff00ff][size=6]fruit tree[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]High Purity Copper Node Tree[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]High Purity Iron Node Tree[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]High Purity Gold Node Tree[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]High Purity Iridium Node Tree[/size][/color]
[/list]These will be available for sale at the Pierre store once the conditions are lifted.
Each tree behaves like a vanilla fruit tree, producing "High Purity ore Node" when mature and in season.

[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]Copper Ore Tree[/size][/color]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]Gold Ore Tree[/size][/color]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]Iridium Ore Tree[/size][/color]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4]Iron Ore Tree[/size][/color]
[/list]These are by-products of the mod creation phase.
These, as the name suggests, bear vanilla ore themselves.
It's not very profitable, but it's a great way to make the farm bustle.
These are unlocked from the start.


[color=#ffff00][size=6]Objects[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4]High Purity Copper Node[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4]High Purity Iron Node[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4]High Purity Gold Node[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4]High Purity Iridium Node[/size][/color]
[/list]These are produced from corresponding fruit trees.
You can also earn revenue by shipping these.
It is originally intended for use in processing, but because it grows on fruit trees, we have set it up so that it can be treated like a vanilla fruit.
It cannot be processed in a vanilla blast furnace. A special machine is required.


[color=#b6d7a8][size=6]Machine[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffd966][size=4]High Purity Ore Node Processing Machine[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffd966][size=4]Special High Purity Ore Node Processing Machine[/size][/color]
[/list]A machine that can process "High Purity ore Node" and convert it to Bar.
This machine is also locked with release conditions.
By adding one node, two bars are created. No fuel is required.
It is faster and more economical than vanilla blast furnaces.
It also works as a substitute for a vanilla blast furnace with the ore itself.
The time it takes is reduced in that case as well.
The Special will create 6 bars with 3 nodes.
The time required is considerably reduced compared to processing the same amount.

[color=#00ff00][size=6]About Radioactive items.
[/size][/color][list]
[*][color=#6aa84f][size=4]High Purity Radioactive Node Tree[/size][/color]
[/list]Locked by condition When released, you will receive an mail and one tree sapling will be attached.
In order not to destroy the balance of the game, "High Purity Radioactive Node" saplings are sold at a very high price compared to other types.
Please take care of the one you get for free, attached to your mail.
If possible, I wanted to use the method of only having one attached and not selling it.
However, we decided to sell it as a remedy because we thought there were too many inconveniences.
Sales are conducted exclusively by Dwarf sales staff.

[list]
[*][color=#93c47d][size=4]High Purity Radioactive Node[/size][/color]
[/list]Fruit prices are modest compared to sapling prices.
This is defined as for processing.

[list]
[*][color=#ffe599][size=4]About processing by machine[/size][/color]
[/list]Considering the rarity of radioactive materials ...
Three "High Purity Radioactive Nodes" can be processed into one bar.
This will be the same for both machines.
The only advantage of using "special" is the short working time.

[color=#ffff00][size=6]Added from v1.8.[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffd966][size=5]High Purity Ore Node Crusher[/size][/color]
[/list]The "High Purity Ore Node" and various bars can be converted into ore.
It requires one coal for fuel to operate.
This machine was added to make better use of the "High Purity Ore Node" trees as they matured and the quality of the harvest increased, leaving a surplus of lower quality material that could not be fully processed.
The "High Purity Radioactive Node" is a bar that has limited use, so it can be converted into ore for use in crafting.
